text:
alyssa: heads up — small cohort seeing doubled lines in invoice PREVIEW at ~03:12 UTC. final invoices look okay but support is getting tickets. leaving here to triage.

sam: traced it quickly. ingest emits provisional metering with epoch=null then joiner emits final with epoch shortly after. preview pipeline surfaces both because dedupe is eventual. sample logs:```
2026-03-22T03:12:01Z INFO ingest req=ri_c7f epoch=null route=embed-heavy tokens=129
2026-03-22T03:12:02Z INFO joiner req=ri_c7f epoch=epoch-20260322-03 tokens=129
```
mira: ugh. users panicking. quick mitigation ideas?
jordan: short-term: console collapse preview rows when a final commit arrives within 5m and shares client_request_id or request_id. show a tiny "provisional hidden" badge and allow expansion for audit. low-risk and reversible.

alyssa: good. medium-term?
sam: two-part: (1) edge can wait a tiny per-route window (20-100ms) for epoch assignment before emitting provisional (feature-flagged). (2) standardize x-client-request-id in SDKs so retries don't create new request ids that break dedupe. add telemetry: metering.provisional_emitted, metering.provisional_wait_ms, metering.duplicate_preview_count.

jordan: better: shadow-preview stream + Redis Lua dedupe store, so we can trial suppression without affecting users. shadow mode routes show metrics but not actual preview until logic confirms finality. canary by tenant segment 5% -> ramp.

ops-bot: INC-4821 alerts muted for affected cohort while investigating.

eng-telemetry-bot: recommended dashboards created: metering/preview-duplicates, metering/provisional-latency (viewers: eng-platform,billing).

mira: i'll own console collapse + modal copy: "Enable billing-consistent-mode: slight median latency increase (~5-25ms) for fewer duplicate preview items and steadier invoice previews." will post mocks.
sam: i'll PR edge flag + telemetry and coordinate SDK header RFC. PR behind ingest.bump/provisional_epoch.
jordan: i'll build shadow-preview consumer + Redis dedupe and add e2e that simulates late-join ordering and retry id churn.

alyssa: timeline: console quick fix today, infra changes behind flags in 48h, canary 7d starting 5%. ops hold alerts during canary. reconvene 11:00 PT with PR links. tag me if you see repeat spikes with sample request_id. :thumbsup:

mira: will post PR + screenshots shortly.
sam: WIP edge PR will be linked in channel.
jordan: WIP metering PR will include metrics and rollback hooks.

alyssa: leaving thread open for follow-ups.
